component.name: Orpheus
component.summary: Modern, fluid music player with synced lyrics and acoustic intelligence
Reproductor de música moderno con letras sincronizadas e inteligencia acústica

description.p: Orpheus is an elegant, high-performance music player engineered for audiophiles and music lovers. Built with Flutter and a native LibVLC / MediaKit audio engine, Orpheus delivers bit-perfect local playback alongside dynamic metadata enrichment and synchronized lyrics.

ul.li: High-fidelity playback of FLAC, ALAC, MP3, AAC, OGG, and WAV.
Automatic synchronized and static lyrics fetching with interactive karaoke-style scrolling.
Acoustic scanning and intelligent mood-based recommendation engine.
Full Linux desktop integration with MPRIS D-Bus controls, media keys, and system sound applets.
Custom glassmorphic Client-Side Decorations (CSD) tailored for GNOME and modern desktop environments.
Smart offline library indexing with fast fuzzy search and playlist management.

description.p: Initial release of Orpheus for Linux with Flatpak packaging, MPRIS support, and glassmorphic desktop interface.
